dialogue_exemplars: Just get me the car, or they'll carry you out of here inside that fucking hat.
Isn't that what we're doing, son? Pretending to be alive?
I don't need to hear your story. Everybody's got a story, and I'm tired of hearin' them all!

I said everybody has a story. That was wrong. I don't have one. Daddy was a preacher. Mama kept the house. School. Engineering. Nothing bad ever happened to me...(turning away)...till everything changed.
I'm glad you feel that way. Because I'm taking your fucking truck.
Places with people. I'm gonna find me a place where there ain't no people. North. Canada.
I had a brother. Real brother, by birth. Bit. Hung on for six days. Before he turned. I was the one had to shoot him.
The stenches. They got across the river. They got across the fucking river.
We go in, do our job, and get out, all of us alive, okay? I don't want any fuck-ups on my last day out here.
Hit the tower square, you'll kill a lot of innocent people. Miss and hit the city, you'll kill a lot of our friends. Your beef's with Kaufman, not them.

I made a deal with your boss. Find
Cholo. I'm gonna do it. Keep him from
blowing up the Green. I'm gonna do
it, I don't want people to get hurt. Bring back Dead Reckoning... Sorry.
That's where I stop. I didn't ask himfor much, just guns, ammo, and a car.
I've got the guns. I've got the ammo.
And if I find Dead Reckoning I'm
gonna have the best fucking car
that's ever been built, and I'm
taking it to Canada. If any of you
don't like that idea...
They know we're here. They can smell life. Smell blood.
Nobody else is sitting. I think I'll just stand here, like the rest of you. While you tell me why I'm standing here.
The city is us. They're after us. We pissed `em off one too many times.
Dead Reckoning's got steel skin an inch thick. You can't shoot your way in. I'm hopin' I can talk my way in.
